population: All 183 Phase 4I 2024 development cases, using their exact common 1301-cell row order and separately selected frozen heavy and very-heavy calibrated predictions
forecast_inputs: Hash-verified Phase 4I selected_2024_probability.npy arrays; no refitting, observation features, or future-time inputs
reference: Phase 4G 2024 IMD 24-hour 03-03 UTC heavy >=64.5 mm and very-heavy >=115.6 mm labels, loaded only after protocol sealing
primary_projection: For p_very_heavy > p_heavy, replace both probabilities by their arithmetic mean. Otherwise leave both unchanged. This is the Euclidean projection onto 0<=p_very_heavy<=p_heavy<=1; it cannot increase the sum of the two squared probability errors for any nested observed label pair.
comparison: Frozen original separate calibrators versus the prespecified symmetric projection on identical 2024 rows; evaluate all rows, the original calibration block, purged block, and model-selection block separately
metrics: fixed 10-bin reliability with counts and observed frequency
selection_rule: No model or threshold selection. Report the projection as a deterministic coherence repair diagnostic. The original 2024 selection block was already used to select calibrators, so no result is an independent validation or calibration claim.
release_rule: No live worker, API, dashboard, calibrated-label, or promotion change. A separately frozen genuinely independent-year reliability test is required before product use.
